pairs.why: Both domes look much alike, but B's dome with its separate module and wide crater scene is a bit more fully built and has the softer, calmer finish of the real cards.
A is a well-shaped, smooth, chunky cowboy hat with a rich warm brown like the real cards, while B has a flat, stiff brim and a fuzzy felt texture that looks wrong for this game.
The two are almost identical; B is very slightly softer and calmer in tone, which is the direction the lessons favour.
B's thick, smoothly rendered coil matches the soft, simplified finish of the real scarf and fan, while A's fine twisted strands are the too-textured look the lessons rejected.
B's chunky, smoother rope reads like the real cards, while A shows busy strand texture.
A's bold, chunky coil has the solid, toy-like mass of the real icons, while B's thin, stringy lasso looks fussier and weaker as an icon.
This is the same pair as p142: B is the smoother, chunkier rope and fits the real cards' finish better than A's textured twists.
This is the same pair as p143: B's smooth, chunky coil is closer to the real cards than A's finely textured strands.
